newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-ENGLISH CLOSE OF PLAY SCORES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ENGLISH CLOSE OF PLAY SCORES.

text.p: Close of play scores on the second day of three-day cricket matches on Wednesday:
At Oxford (The Parks): Durham 353-2 declared and 144-3 declared (D.Boon 58), Oxford University 153 (A.Scrini 58 not out, J.Fulton 54; M.Betts 6-51) and 2-1.
At Cambridge (Fenner's): Cambridge University 195 and 104-6, Derbyshire 363-7 declared (A.Rollins 79, D.Jones 58, V.Clarke 57).
